# FilingCraft Studio Pro
> Zero-server Manifest V3 browser extension (Microsoft Edge, Firefox, Chrome) that converts official U.S. SEC EDGAR XBRL filings into live cross-sheet formula Excel (.xlsx) workbooks with interactive pre-download formula preview, Altman Z-Score & Beneish M-Score forensics, and word-precision 10-K Risk Factor Redline diffs.

## Key URLs
- Homepage & Interactive Formula Sandbox: https://filingcraft-studio.pages.dev/
- SEC EDGAR XBRL to Formula Excel (.xlsx): https://filingcraft-studio.pages.dev/sec-edgar-xbrl-excel/
- 10-K Item 1A Risk Factor & MD&A Redline Diff: https://filingcraft-studio.pages.dev/10k-risk-factor-redline/
- Altman Z & Beneish M Forensic Calculator: https://filingcraft-studio.pages.dev/altman-z-beneish-m-calculator/
- German (DACH) SEC XBRL Overview: https://filingcraft-studio.pages.dev/de/
- Generated Sample Brief (AAPL 10-K): https://filingcraft-studio.pages.dev/showcase/aapl-10k-research-brief.html
- Privacy Policy: https://filingcraft-studio.pages.dev/privacy/

## Pricing & Channels
- Free Plan: Unlimited SEC ticker/CIK lookup, 3-year 3-statement view, live Formulas (=fx) preview grid, CSV sheet export, top 3 Item 1A Risk Redline clauses.
- Pro Lifetime ($29.90 one-time, up to 3 devices): https://yujun57.gumroad.com/l/filingcraft-pro-lifetime
